entities.summary: Marcel Gromaire was a French painter. He painted many works on social subjects and is often associated with Social Realism, but Gromaire can be said to have created an independent oeuvre distinct from groups and movements. Marcel Gromaire was a painters & sculptors from Noyelles-sur-Sambre (1892-07-24, Noyelles-sur-Sambre–1971-04-11). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
